title: orch add-on view v1 (stdout of `orch <name> view --json`)
description: Pulled by the dashboard (timeout 2 s, max 256 KB). Declarative blocks only; the only way back is a list row's `toggle`/`actions` (fixed ops, see $defs/action), never a command; every string is plain text (rendered with textContent, never as HTML). Unknown block types are skipped. See addon-manifest.md, Views.

generated_at.description: When the add-on computed this view. The dashboard shows it as 'as of HH:MM'.

notice.description: Optional one-line state, e.g. 'The scheduler is stopped: nothing starts by itself.'

button.description: Optional: one button shown with the notice. `action.op` must be one the dashboard knows (`addon.start`, which starts background work, or `addon.refresh`, which reads the view again; args none); unknown ops are not drawn.

header.description: Optional, drawn at the right of the page heading: a status pill, one quiet link and/or one primary button. A button's `action.op` must be one the dashboard knows (`link.share`, `addon.refresh`); unknown ops are not drawn.

link.description: A ticket id (opens the ticket detail), an https URL (opens in a new tab, rel=noopener noreferrer), addon:<path>: a page of THIS add-on, resolved only against its own checked [page] url (no '..', no leading '/'), or app:<page>[/<sub>]: a page of the dashboard itself (home, tickets, notes, chat, settings, addon), e.g. app:settings/phone. Nothing else.

action.description: A request the dashboard may send back, never a command line. `op` names one entry of the dashboard's fixed op table; unknown ops are not shown. For an add-on's own verbs the op is `addon.act`: the dashboard runs `orch <this add-on> act <verb> -- <target>` for the add-on whose view this is (it cannot name another add-on).

pagelink.description: A quiet link with a label: `to` is a link (see $defs/link).

meta.description: Optional quiet text at the right of the block heading, e.g. '13-19 November'.

empty.description: Optional. What a block with no rows shows: a mark, a title, one sentence and one button or link.

count.description: Optional number shown quietly at the right of the heading.

span.description: Optional: two consecutive `half` blocks are drawn side by side (stacked on a narrow window).

compact.description: Optional: one line per row; `meta` cells in columns, `actions` shown on hover or focus.

above.description: Optional: the heading sits above the card instead of inside it.

meta.description: Quiet cells after the title in a `compact` list.

detail.description: Makes the row expandable (accordion): collapsed shows title, subtitle and toggle; expanded shows these labelled fields.

lines.description: Several short lines instead of one value (e.g. recent events).

tickets.description: Tickets linked to this row, shown in the expanded part; each links to the ticket.

toggle.description: An On/Off switch on the collapsed row. `action` carries the NEW state in its args when sent.

text.description: Short visible words that say what the switch turns on (e.g. Repeats): the table column heading and, at phone width, the words beside the switch. `label` stays the full name for screen readers.

actions.description: Buttons in the expanded part. `confirm` = a short question; the dashboard shows a small Yes/No (no typed word) before sending.

more.description: How many items were left out (shown as '+N more').

time.description: HH:MM, already in the user's local time.

every.description: Optional. A repeat that runs more often than hourly, shown as ONE item for the day instead of one per run: plain words such as "Every 5 min", shown in place of the time. `time` is then the first (or next) run of the day.

note.description: Optional muted second line, e.g. "next 15:05 · 288 runs/day".

full.description: Optional. The whole title when `title` was shortened with an ellipsis; shown as hover text.

type.description: duration = seconds (number); date = RFC 3339 UTC or YYYY-MM-DD; tone = a tone value shown as a dot

subtitle.description: A quiet line under the first cell.

links.description: Optional: a link of its own for a cell by column key (e.g. a pull request number to GitHub, a ticket key to its ticket). `link` stays the first cell's link.

tones.description: Optional: a text cell by column key drawn as a coloured chip with that tone (its text stays the word).

toggle.description: An On/Off switch on the collapsed row. `action` carries the NEW state in its args when sent.

text.description: Short visible words that say what the switch turns on (e.g. Repeats): the table column heading and, at phone width, the words beside the switch. `label` stays the full name for screen readers.

actions.description: Buttons in the expanded part. `confirm` = a short question; the dashboard shows a small Yes/No (no typed word) before sending.

compact.description: Optional: one line per row; long text cells end in an ellipsis (the whole text is the hover text).

filter.description: Optional: the key of a text column; tabs above the table (All, then each value of that column with its count, in the order the rows have) show only the rows with that value.

fold.description: Optional: under All, only the first N rows show, then a 'Show N more' button.

chart.description: A bar chart of a few numbers over a short span (e.g. per day). Drawn as plain bars with a legend; each bar's numbers show on hover or focus. Two consecutive `half` blocks sit side by side.

labels.description: One label per bar, oldest first (e.g. '6 Nov' ... 'Today').

tone.description: The colour of the series: neutral blue, good green, warn yellow, bad red, needs-you the brand colour.

stacked.description: Optional: the series sit on top of each other instead of side by side.

flow.description: Work moving from left to right through a few stages (e.g. a merge queue: being checked, in line, merged lately). Each stage has a headline, small linked chips, and optionally a progress bar or a row of small bars. Stacked on a narrow window.

text.description: A quiet line under the headline.

active.description: Optional: the stage where work happens now; drawn with a coloured edge.

place.description: Optional: a small number in front (a place in line).

hint.description: Hover text, e.g. the pull request's title.

more.description: How many items were left out (shown as '+N').

label.description: What the bar says to a screen reader.

bars.description: Small bars, oldest first (e.g. recent groups: height = size, colour = how it went).

bars_label.description: What the bars say together, for a screen reader.

footnote.description: One quiet line under the page, with an optional link.

settings.description: A card of settings rows: a quiet label on the left, the value (and a note) next to it, an optional button at the right. A `radio` block that follows is drawn inside the same card.

split.description: List and panel (added 17 Nov, ORCH-326): a slim list of things on the left (state mark, title, state word, one optional main button) and the chosen one in full on the right; on a phone the list first, then the panel with a way back. The chosen item has an address (`?<param>=<id>` after the page's hash). Every action of an item must name that item's own `id` as its target. Older dashboards skip this block.

title.description: Optional label of the list for screen readers, e.g. 'Services'.

param.description: The address word of the chosen item, e.g. 'svc'.

splitButton.description: A button: `action` (sent as is; for `addon.act` the target must be the item's id) or `link` (a ticket, an https page or a dashboard page).

state.description: The state word and its tone (good = running, bad = failing, neutral = stopped).

action.description: Optional main button on the list row (Start or Stop).

question.description: Optional question about this item, pinned above the list at every width (once per page).

text.description: One quiet line under the title: what it is.

buttons.description: In order (Start or Stop, then Restart). Open log is added by the dashboard when there is a log.

tone.description: Draws a state dot before the value.

link.description: The value is a link (a ticket, an https page or a dashboard page).

switch.description: An On/Off switch before the value; a click sends `action` (the view puts the verb for the NEW state in it).

note.description: One quiet line after the facts.

empty.description: Shown when there are no lines yet.

danger.description: One action set apart at the bottom in the danger style (Remove). A click opens the shared dialog with `confirm`: what will happen, a Keep button and this button; no typed word.

radio.description: One choice out of a few. The option with `selected` is the saved one. Choosing another sends its `action` (`addon.act`, a plain verb and a plain-word target) or, with `link`, goes to the page where that choice is made. The new state shows after the add-on answers: nothing changes on screen first.
